method: Separate review of the saved report against its test source and console log, evidence manifest, reconciler output, issue search, and repository diff.
score_reason: The report gives the model formula, data layout, numerical checks, and explicit limits. Its required headings make the structure uniform, but the details remain specific to this test.
confidence_reason: This short report is checked against local evidence; the rating is editorial and not independently calibrated.

examples.impact: The reader gets the exact recovery and agreement tolerances for both links.
examples.quote: The focused test passed with one live Julia bridge test covering both links. Each link fit one TMB model and one Julia model. Both engines converged; each estimated the log-SD slope within 0.65 of truth, agreed within 0.4, matched log likelihood within 0.05, and returned fitted group SDs within 0.04.

science_gate_reason: The reported covariance and group-level SD construction match the synthetic generator; results are bounded to the tested fixture. The report explicitly says no independent likelihood oracle or interval-coverage claim was used.
facts_gate_reason: Fit counts and thresholds were checked against the test source and console output; evidence counts against reconciliation; source hashes against the manifest.
references_gate_reason: The report makes no external literature claims.
calibration_status: Earlier after-task assessment records were viewed as format examples; no human ratings or calibration controls were used.
